intro.title: JWT Storage & Decode in React
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a simple Vue application that securely stores a JSON Web Token (JWT) in the browser's localStorage and decodes it to display user information. You will learn the core concept of managing authentication state and handling sensitive data in a client-side application. The main technologies involved are Vue's reactive state with the Composition API (ref), lifecycle hooks (onMounted), and the JavaScript Web Token library (jwt-decode) for parsing the token. This hands-on project will help you understand how to safely handle JWTs, a common authentication method in modern web apps.
intro.usecase: JWT storage and decoding is essential for user authentication in modern web applications. When users log into platforms like admin dashboards, e-commerce sites, or banking portals, their session data is securely stored as JWTs. Developers implement this pattern to maintain user state across page reloads, display personalized content, and protect sensitive routes. For example, a dashboard might decode the JWT to show the user's name and role, while an e-commerce site uses it to persist shopping cart items between sessions.
